verdict.rationale: Docs reduce skill creation to a single `SKILL.md` file that Claude picks up and can invoke via `/skill-name`. The official repo gives a two-command install path (`/plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills`, then `/plugin install`). A recorded runtime probe completed a real keyless one-command install of a skill into `.claude/skills/` that read back cleanly. Together this supports a very fast path from nothing to an installed skill. Missing for 10: an explicitly labeled step-by-step quickstart page, any timing evidence for the under-five-minutes claim, and hands-on confirmation that the freshly installed skill actually runs inside Claude.
